title: Understanding Down Syndrome Stereotypes in LLM-Based Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of LLM-generated personas by caregivers and specialists to identify stereotypical content, tone, and interface constraints, alongside quantitative measurement using a fine-tuned transformer ensemble model to calculate the 'Average Stereotype Probability' of generated sentences.
Sentence-level stereotype classification and detection using fine-tuned transformer models (ELECTRA, RoBERTa, DeBERTa) trained and evaluated on a subset of the Multi-Grain Stereotype Dataset (MGSD).

Sentence-level stereotype classification and detection using fine-tuned transformer models trained and evaluated on a subset of the Multi-Grain Stereotype Dataset (MGSD) to identify biased assumptions regarding professions.
